_comment: Shared attribute maps for schema conversion of types whose attributes IFC4 INSERTED, REORDERED or RETYPED mid-list relative to IFC2X3 (#10763), so neither list is a name prefix of the other and a trim or pad would shift values. A target slot takes the source value of the same-named attribute or of the `renamed` pair ([IFC2X3 name, IFC4 name]); every other target slot is $ and every other source value is reported dropped. `retyped`: same name in both lists, but a value of one type is invalid in the other, so it is not carried. `upOnly`: same name, IFC4 widened the reference type, so an upgrade carries it and a downgrade drops it (only where IFC2X3 does not require the slot). `setOfOne`: an IFC2X3 single reference that IFC4 made a SET; an upgrade wraps it, a downgrade keeps the first member and reports the rest dropped. IFC4X3 declares the same lists as IFC4 for every type here. `why` quotes the IFC4 change notes (IFC4.3 documentation, which carries them). Pinned in both twins: rust/export/src/schema_attr_maps.rs and packages/export/src/schema-converter-attr-maps.ts each compare their table with this file; their conversions are pinned by schema_upconvert_sweep.json rows. DO NOT hand-edit to make a test pass.

'Subtyped from IfcResourceLevelRelationship, order of attributes changed.' RelatedApprovals: 'The cardinality of this attribute has been changed to SET.'
'Data type of RasterCode has been corrected to BINARY' (IFC2X3 declared BOOLEAN). IfcSurfaceTexture: 'Attribute TextureType replaces by Mode, attributes Parameter and MapsTo added'
IfcSurfaceTexture: 'Attribute TextureType replaces by Mode, attributes Parameter and MapsTo added'. URLReference is the IFC2X3 UrlReference (IfcIdentifier to IfcURIReference, both strings)
IfcSurfaceTexture: 'Attribute TextureType replaces by Mode, attributes Parameter and MapsTo added'
